job.title: Project Manager @ stichd ('s-Hertogenbosch, North Brabant, Netherlands)
job.description:
Transition is the magic word at STICHD these days. We are in an exciting phase as a company, and our Program Management team plays an important role in ensuring we bring strategy and execution together from a program and project point of view.

As a Project Manager, you will be responsible for the planning, execution and closing of projects according to scope, deadlines and budget. You ensure alignment between cross-functional project team members and other stakeholders to drive business success. Your main responsibility will be to deliver measurable project results, managing implementation milestones and due dates, and creating awareness of dependencies and risks. You keep the bigger picture in mind while making sure plans are translated into action.

The Project Manager we are looking for leads strategic business change projects in which new or revised ways of working come first and technology supports them: from product creation and go-to-market to order intake, fulfilment and our business models. Your stakeholders sit across the entire value chain, including Product, Sales (B2B and B2C), Business Operations & Logistics, Finance and IT.

Many of the people you work with are business experts who run projects alongside their day job. Structure, consistency and follow-up are what you bring, and you help them grow their own project skills. Your first assignments include our stage-gate process for product creation (concept to market) and other cross-functional projects on our roadmap.

**Your Mission**

**Project Planning**

• Define the executional approach for project’s scope and deliverables in collaboration with stakeholders.

• Define detailed project plans, including resources, timelines and budget.

**Project Execution**

• Lead teams in the implementation of project plans.

• Assign tasks and responsibilities to team members and follow up on progress.

• Monitor progress and recognize upcoming challenges or risks. Define, propose and implement countermeasures.

• Bring structure, planning and follow-up into projects run by business teams who are new to project work.

**Quality Control**

• Ensure project deliverables meet quality standards and stakeholder expectations.

**Budget Management**

• Track project expenses and ensure they stay within budget.

• Prepare financial reports and forecasts related to project expenditures.

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**

• Plan well in advance and report potential escalations to senior management and other stakeholders in a timely manner.

• Provide regular updates on status and successes to program stakeholders, the wider company and your colleagues within the PMO and strategy team.

**Coaching & PMO**

• Act as PM buddy for up to two in-line projects led by business colleagues: fortnightly check-ins, plan reviews and escalation.

• Help in-line project managers apply our project method, templates and stage gates.

• Keep project data in our portfolio tool (Smartsheet) complete, accurate and current.

**Project Closing**

• Oversee the completion of project deliverables and ensure they are handed over to the relevant stakeholders.

• Conduct post-project evaluations to identify successes and areas for improvement.

**Your Talent**

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Management or another relevant field.

• 6 to 8+ years of experience in project management, delivering cross-functional business change.

• Demonstrated: you have led projects that changed ways of working across several departments, ideally in product creation, go-to-market or order fulfilment.

• Demonstrated: you have coached colleagues who are new to project work and helped them run their own projects.

• Certified in a project management method, such as PRINCE2, IPMA or Agile, and able to apply it pragmatically.

• Comfortable with portfolio and planning tools; experience with Smartsheet is a plus.

• A strategic mindset and experience translating strategic thinking into tactical planning.

• Excellent communication, leadership and interpersonal skills.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• A process-oriented, structured and organized approach to managing multiple priorities.

• You know how to bring different stakeholders together and keep projects moving forward.

• Fluent in English; Dutch is a plus.

job.title: Business Development Manager AutoStore Germany (m/w/d) @ KARDEX (Neuburg an der Kammel, BY, DE)
job.description:
Kardex AutoStore is a global leader in high-speed Automatic Storage and Retrieval Systems (ASRS)—boosting storage capacity by up to four times. Trusted worldwide, our cutting-edge technology strengthens Kardex’s portfolio of advanced intralogistics solutions, helping businesses achieve smarter, faster, and more efficient order fulfillment. We are excited to expand our presence in the DACH region.
  
  
The Business Development Manager strategically develops the Kardex AutoStore business within the DACH region. This role identifies attractive market segments, applications and target accounts, translating market insights into targeted business-development activities that build a sustainable pipeline of qualified opportunities and support regional growth objectives.  
  
Working autonomously and in close cooperation with local Sales and Marketing teams and the EMEA organization, the BDM builds customer relationships, engages with key decision-makers and develops an understanding of their business challenges, assesses logistics processes and business requirements, and evaluates the strategic, technical and commercial fit of potential opportunities. The role develops preliminary solution concepts and indicative budgets to support opportunity qualification and customers’ initial investment decisions.  
  
Once opportunities are sufficiently qualified, the BDM coordinates a structured handover to the responsible local Sales organization ensuring a clear understanding of customer requirements, commercial potential and proposed next steps, and may continue supporting their development in coordination with Sales. Close cooperation with AutoStore, other Kardex entities and selected business partners, together with regular travel throughout DACH, is essential to the role.

**Your tasks**

**Success in the role comes from candidates that are dedicated to the following:**

  

* Identify market potential and translate insights into clear business-development priorities and a measurable pipeline of qualified opportunities.
* Build trusted relationships with customers, stakeholders and decision-makers, with the ability to engage and influence at different organisational levels.
* Understand customer logistics processes, investment drivers and decision-making criteria and translate these into potential business opportunities and preliminary solution requirements.
* Apply sound commercial and technical judgment when assessing solution fit and deciding which opportunities to pursue, balancing customer needs, feasibility, profitability and strategic value.
* Maintain current market, technology and competitor knowledge and collaborate effectively across the organization, to leverage expertise, share market insights and ensure effective opportunity development and handover.

**Your profile**

**Training and Education**

* Degree in Engineering, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration or a related field.
* Fluent in **German** and English; German at native or professional level and English at full professional working proficiency.

**Professional Experience**

* Relevant experience in Business Development or Solution Sales, preferably in **intralogistics** or **industrial automation**.
* Proven track record in developing sales opportunities and projects.

**Other Requirement**s

* Good understanding of logistics and IT processes.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of the assigned territory.
* Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills.

**Main Accountabilities**

* Analyse DACH market trends, customer needs and competitor activities to identify target segments, applications and accounts.
* Develop and execute territory plans aligned with local and EMEA AutoStore business strategies.
* Generate new business opportunities and build a qualified sales pipeline.
* Conduct initial customer meetings, visits and site assessments to understand operational needs and buying processes.
* Develop preliminary AutoStore solution concepts and budgets in collaboration with Solution Design and technical experts.
* Qualify opportunities and coordinate structured handovers to the local Sales teams.
* Collaborate with Sales and Marketing on lead generation, campaigns and customer engagement.
* Represent Kardex at trade fairs, industry events and customer meetings. Regular travel across Germany, Austria and Switzerland is required.
* Maintain relationships with AutoStore, Kardex entities and business partners, contributing to EMEA initiatives.

**Leadership and Competencies**

* Entrepreneurial, proactive and results-oriented mindset.
* Strong ownership and ability to independently develop new business.
* Analytical skills and sound commercial judgement.
* Customer-focused approach with an emphasis on commercially viable solutions.
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to influence stakeholders across functions and regions.
* Ability to work independently in an international and remote environment.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Development of target markets, applications and key accounts across DACH.
* Achievement of agreed territory development plans.
* Number and value of qualified opportunities generated.
* Qualified pipeline value and coverage against business targets.
* Contribution to AutoStore order intake and booking margin.
* Contribution to local Marketing activities and EMEA strategic initiatives.
